title: Ekhein
extract:
The Ekhein is an  Entrati Hammer. Its Heavy Attacks increase its damage and Attack Speed.

Characteristics
This weapon deals pure  Impact damage.
Landing a Heavy Attack grants the Heavy Insight buff for 8 seconds, increasing Damage by 80% and Attack Speed by 20%.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (30.00%)
Very high total damage (340)
High damage × attack speed (370.30)
High attack range (2.80 m)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
High crit chance (30.00%)
Very high total damage (680)
High damage × attack speed (740.61)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Above average status chance (15.00%)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
High crit chance (30.00%)
Very high total damage (1,020)
Very high damage × attack speed (1110.92)
High attack range (2.80 m)
High status chance (15.00%)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low block angle (50°)
Very low follow through (0.4x)
Very low attack speed (0.767x animation speed)
Very low status chance (15.00%)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Very low attack speed (0.767x animation speed)
Very low block angle (50°)
Very low follow through (0.4x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Very low attack speed (0.767x animation speed)
Very low block angle (50°)
Very low follow through (0.4x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
Ekhein's blueprint is sold by Bird 3 of  Cavia for  15,000, requiring Rank 3 - Colleague.

Trivia
In the Whispers in the Walls Quest, Loid can be seen using the Ekhein to smash Albrecht Entrati's casket.
